name: Hotel Berghof
beschreibung: The Hotel Berghof is situated in a sunny, peaceful setting at Nesselwängle 59 in Tyrol's scenic Tannheimer Tal, framed by the impressive scenery of the Allgäu Alps. Decorated in an authentic Tyrolean alpine cottage style, the guest rooms feature contemporary en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies presenting open views of Mount Rotflüh and Krinnenspitze. After active hours exploring the alpine terrain, the on-site sauna facility and quiet garden lawn invite guests to relax. A nutritious breakfast buffet filled with local regional specialities is prepared every morning. The property is ideally placed: summer brings high-altitude hikes, via ferratas, and refreshing swims at Lake Haldensee. In winter, groomed valley cross-country ski tracks pass right by and local ski slopes cater superbly to families.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy country-style hotel in Nesselwängle in the Tannheimer Tal with balcony rooms, sauna, and views of the Allgäu Alps.
